title: My Son Forged A Dissolution, Sold My $740K Rare Books, And Left Me $4,600. So I Voided The Sale
description: I drained my $128,000 nursing pension to open a rare book conservation studio with my son, only for him to forge a dissolution and sell a $740,000 first-folio restoration for a $4,600 colophon check. I found the original notarized agreement hidden inside an 18th-century Geneva Bible and voided the sale before he was led out in handcuffs. Now he sews book signatures in my shop under a canvas apron that says Stitched in Lies. #FamilyBetrayal #ProRevenge #RareBooks
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY $740K BOOKS AND LEFT ME $4,600
pinned_comment: If your own son handed you a $4,600 colophon check after selling the $740,000 first-folio collection you funded with thirty-two years of night shifts, would you void the sale or walk away? Tell me what you would have done and share your own family betrayal story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: I DRAINED $128,000 FROM THIRTY TWO YEARS OF NIGHT SHIFTS
